info.title: Übel Blatt (ITA)
info.synopsis: In tutto il paese circolano delle voci: quando chi brandisce la spada nera estrae la sua lama, chiunque si trovi sulla sua strada viene fatto a pezzi! Köinzell è il misterioso ragazzo che brandisce questa spada con abilità, ma può essere veramente il responsabile di tutte le sanguinose voci che circolano? Tra la storia sulle Lance Traditrici, quattro potenti guerrieri che si pensava fossero stati sconfitti dai Sette Eroi, e questi ultimi, la forza del giovane verrà messa alla prova fino al limite. Alla fine della battaglia, solo la scioccante verità rimarrà sopra i cadaveri dei suoi nemici...

episodes.title: Durch Bruch (Break Through)
episodes.synopsis: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

episodes.title: Unter Morgen Monde (Under the Morning Moons)
episodes.synopsis: During a deadly exchange against Rangzatz, Köinzell is thrust down to the depths of the underground monastery. However, Köinzell had visited this fortress with Ergnach in the past. And now, as Köinzell fends off the elite warrior monks, he releases the magic circle spell his comrade had once sacrificed his life to conjure.

episodes.title: Langer Regen (The Long Rain)
episodes.synopsis: When Köinzell reaches the Seven Heroes' encampment, he is forced to confront the immense power and glory his former comrades have amassed since they murdered him in cold blood. Despondent, Köinzell is standing in the rain when a masked avenger makes an attempt on his life.

episodes.title: Koinzell
episodes.synopsis: Chiliarch Fargo invites Wied and Aht to the mayor's manor at night. That night, the two are met by a horde of undead bandits risen through dark Wischtechian magic. Simultaneously, Fargo launches a brutal assault on the refugees, including Peepi. Under the moonlit sky, Köinzell unleashes the power of his Black Sword.

episodes.title: Die Burg vom Helden (The Castle of the Hero)
episodes.synopsis: Schtemwölech welcomes Köinzell's assault with a powerful blast from Dragon's Maw, a Wischtechian magic artillery. Köinzell diverts its attack and breaches the defenses of the castle.Inside, Geranpen is faced with the ultimate choice: either remain loyal to his Lord or seek out the truth.

episodes.title: Schtemwolech
episodes.synopsis: In the depths of the castle altar, Schtemwölech had been conducting vile experiments on demihuman girls. By infusing fairyblood to his, the landgrave had attained a physique of steel through a Wischtechian ritual. Now, Köinzell must confront this former friend to put an end to his twisted plan.

episodes.title: Der leere Sarg (The Empty Coffin)
episodes.synopsis: A state funeral is held to pay tribute to Schtemwölech's glorious rule. Peepi and Altea reconvene with Köinzell, who had taken shelter in the mountains. As the company watch the funeral procession lay the landgrave's coffin to rest at the sacred burial site, Köinzell vows vengeance against the six remaining heroes.

episodes.title: Der Heldmorder (The Hero-Killer)
episodes.synopsis: In a fit of paranoia, the deranged Batterygrave Barestar commands his men to search for the Hero-Killer in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, where Köinzell sought shelter. Meanwhile, under Glenn's leadership, Elsaria's company hunts for the treacherous rebel.

episodes.title: Junge Blatter (Young Leaves)
episodes.synopsis: At the Hall of Swords, Glenn entrusts a manhunt mission to Ichfeis, a slave knight vying to restore the title Blatt Meister. Meanwhile, in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, Köinzell's fight against Elsaria and company takes a desperate turn. Eager to prove herself, Aht recklessly charges in, only to sustain an injury.

episodes.title: Gegenangriff (Counterattack)
episodes.synopsis: Köinzell's stand against the batterygrave's military inspires the townsfolks of Jullas-Abllas to take up arms. Their bravery even convinces Elsaria, the Elector's daughter, to side with the Free City. Just as the tides are about to turn in Köinzell's favor, a powerful blast from a magic artillery cuts through the sky.

episodes.title: Gefuhl zu... (With Feeling)
episodes.synopsis: As Barestar's Floating Castle and magic artillery wreak havoc on all, the people recognize Köinzell's stand to protect the city and call him for what he is, a hero. Meanwhile, Elsaria and company thwart Barestar's men from snatching Marquis Glenn's latest Flagship of the Dragon Airship Fleet, and launch a counteroffensive.

episodes.title: Neues Schwert (New Sword)
episodes.synopsis: Ichfeis, a slave knight who seeks to earn his freedom, faces Köinzell the Hero-Killer in a fated duel. As they cross blades, Ichfeis coaxes Köinzell to launch the Black Wing, the crowning technique of Ludift-style swordsmanship, and delivers his own imperfect rendition. Köinzell strikes back with a magnificent assault.

info.title: Jenny la tennista - Seconda serie (2° parte) (ITA)
info.synopsis: Stagione conclusiva della saga di "Ace o nerae!" ("Jenny la tennista"). Hiromi Oka continua a migliorare il suo gioco e completa il suo percorso di crescita, sia sportivo che umano.

related.title: Jenny la tennista - Seconda serie (1° parte)

variants.title: Jenny la tennista - Seconda serie (1° parte)

related.title: Jenny la tennista - Seconda serie (2° parte)

variants.title: Jenny la tennista - Seconda serie (2° parte)

info.title: Fantazoo (ITA)
info.synopsis: Trasposizione animata di una serie olandese di fumetti a strisce, ancora oggi pubblicata da diversi quotidiani e settimanali dei Paesi Bassi, intitolata Ox Tales (traducibile letteralmente dall'inglese come I racconti del bue) e creata da Wil Raymakers e Thijs Wilms. In un mondo di matrice agreste dove la natura è incontaminata e popolata di ogni sorta di animale antropomorfo, si svolgono le esileranti avventure di un bue e della sua amica tartaruga Alvaro è un gran lavoratore, forte, ingegnoso e sempre carico di ottimismo. Il bue (conosciuto con il nome di Alvaro nell'edizione italiana) è amolto altruista, ma il più delle volte nel tentativo di aiutare gli altri animali del bosco finisce per complicare la vita a tutti, compreso se stesso creando situazioni comiche che lo vedono, suo malgrado, protagonista.

info.title: Fireball
info.synopsis: La serie si svolge nel 47° millennio e ruota intorno a due robot che abitano in una gigantesca villa; la duchessa ginoide Drossel von Flügel e il suo massiccio servitore aracnoide ciclopico, Gedächtnis. Drossel è stato fabbricato con la mente di una ragazza di 14 anni mentre Gedächtnis con la mente di un uomo sui 50 anni sebbene entrambi siano noti per avere almeno 2.800 anni. Nel corso della storia si scopre che Gedächtnis è legato alla famiglia von Flugel da 2.800 anni e che era suo dovere rimanere al fianco di Drossel per tutto quel tempo. Durante il corso degli eventi, i protagonisti stringono un'amicizia con Schadenfreude, robot simile ad una scimmia, dove quest'ultimo si unisce al gruppo dei due robot.

episodes.title: Watching the Water-Living Animals
episodes.synopsis: Drossel demands of Gedächtnis that he show her images of dolphins.
Gedächtnis is having some trouble with his eye.

episodes.title: The Day the Dolphin Flew
episodes.synopsis: Drossel discovers some odd headgear.

episodes.title: St. Elmo`s Fire
episodes.synopsis: Drossel wants to know if the Tower has received any letters.

episodes.title: Demon of the Frontal Lobe
episodes.synopsis: Gedächtnis has more technical problems - this time with his brain.

episodes.title: An Unwavering Heart
episodes.synopsis: Enemy bombardment causes problems at Tempest Tower.

episodes.title: Prophecy
episodes.synopsis: Drossel considers peace-talks with the humans.

episodes.title: The Monkey in the Seat
episodes.synopsis: Drossel is having trouble getting comfortable.

episodes.title: Butterfly
episodes.synopsis: Drossel wants a pet.

episodes.title: Final Stop
episodes.synopsis: A rainstorm brings to light Tempest Tower's lack of resources.

episodes.title: Intruders
episodes.synopsis: Drossel's exercises are interrupted.

episodes.title: The Virtual Eye
episodes.synopsis: The monkey-robot's antics cause problems of a decidedly ocular nature.

episodes.title: The Place Where Dreams Are Born
episodes.synopsis: Gedächtnis has both good news and bad news.

info.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
info.synopsis: Sae Iwata è una ragazza più grande della media che prova timidezza per la sua altezza mentre il suo amico d'infanzia Koki, che da piccolo era gracile, crescendo è diventato un bel ragazzo. La ragazza pensava si fossero allontanati, ma durante l'ultimo festival sportivo delle medie si sono riuniti. Ora, arrivati alle superiori, Sae si rende conto di provare dei sentimenti per lui ma anche di non essere l'unica ad essere interessata all'amico. La vera domanda è una sola... per chi prova sentimenti Koki?

related.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun

variants.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
A Star Brighter Than the Sun

episodes.title: The Day I Reached out My Hand
episodes.synopsis: Sae Iwata is a slightly tougher-than-average girl. Her first love, Koki Kamishiro, was once a delicate and fragile boy, but now, in their third year of junior high, he has grown into a cool and popular young man. Although they have drifted apart, her feelings remain unchanged. When they are paired up to help prepare for the sports festival, Sae’s long-hidden first love begins to stir once more.

episodes.title: Call My Name
episodes.synopsis: Sae and Kamishiro end up in the same high school and class. Assigned to the same group for trash pickup, Kamishiro gets into a sudden argument with a classmate. As Sae steps in, he instinctively calls her by her first name, bringing back a flood of childhood memories. Meanwhile, another girl, Hisui, seems to be drawn to Kamishiro as well.

episodes.title: No Matter How Far
episodes.synopsis: Knowing Kamishiro has a crush on someone weighs heavily on Sae’s heart. Still, during their school trip, Sae finds herself unable to take her eyes off him. Her friends, Hisui and Kagawa, try their best to support her, but Sae always ends up showing her awkward side around Kamishiro.

episodes.title: He`s Still There Even When I Close My Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro admits to Sae that he has feelings for someone, describing his crush as "a star that shines brighter than the sun." The words pierce her heart, but she chooses to support him nonetheless. All the same, as Kamishiro continues to treat Sae just like always, she finds herself torn between her feelings and her resolve.

episodes.title: Jumping and Swinging
episodes.synopsis: After the school trip, a class-versus-class jump rope tournament is set to take place, and Sae and Kamishiro are chosen to swing the rope. Despite the unexpected pairing, Sae tries not to be too conscious of Kamishiro. As practice begins, things do not go as smoothly as expected. One day after school, Sae spots Kagawa practicing alone behind the school building.

episodes.title: Brains, Heart, and Courage
episodes.synopsis: One day, Sae takes a day off from school. The next day, Kamishiro gets injured during club practice and also takes a day off. As they lend each other their notebooks to catch up on missed classes, they begin exchanging messages. A small incident leads Kamishiro to realize that Sae likes someone. Unaware of Sae's true feelings, he encourages her to go for it.

episodes.title: Sun-Shower
episodes.synopsis: Kamishiro is selected as one of the main cast members for the class play. Struggling with his lines, he turns to Sae for help. As they rehearse, they make a promise to go see a movie together during summer break. On the big day, the class's performance is going smoothly until Sae suddenly bursts onto the stage.

episodes.title: Ten Years
episodes.synopsis: With school events behind her, Sae throws herself into club activities. Just then, the date for her long-awaited movie outing with Kamishiro is set. However, a chance encounter with Kamishiro's cousin, Subaru, leaves Sae feeling uneasy, as something Kamishiro once said about his crush comes back to her.

episodes.title: Someone`s Feelings
episodes.synopsis: After their movie date, Sae once again realizes that unless she expresses her feelings, Kamishiro will never notice them. Learning from Hisui that the school festival is a time for love confessions, she decides to tell him during the after-party. While preparing for the event, Sae finds Subaru's painting vandalized, and the situation makes her look like the culprit.

episodes.title: Rumors
episodes.synopsis: As preparations for the class exhibit progress, Sae tries to talk to Kamishiro, but the timing never seems right. On top of that, Hisui points out that she has been spending most of her time with Ayukawa. Just when Sae decides to be more proactive, Kamishiro makes an unexpected proposal.

episodes.title: A Star Without a Constellation
episodes.synopsis: Worried about Subaru, Sae visits the nurse's office. There, Kamishiro notices Subaru trying to act fine and offers to help during the school festival. Sae feels a twinge of loneliness, as she had planned to confess her feelings to him then. However, Kamishiro makes it clear that he will not be available during his reception desk shift with Sae.

episodes.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
episodes.synopsis: After hearing that Kamishiro plans to confess to the person he likes, Sae impulsively blurts out her feelings to him. Overcome with emotion, she runs away, convinced she has been rejected. She hides in the gym storage room, crying until the door slowly opens and Kamishiro appears.

info.title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
info.synopsis: Kaji è una persona benvoluta da tutti, ma in realtà disprezza le persone e di nascosto le valuta. Durante un viaggio di lavoro viene accompagnato da Fukami, un collega che si veste in maniera così trasandata da ricevere uno zero come valutazione. Tuttavia dopo un bagno, la valutazione su Fukami cambia completamente! Inizia così la storia fra un playboy narcisista e un otaku dal corpo attraente...

info.title: Psycho Armor Govarian
info.synopsis: Nel bel mezzo di un'invasione su larga scala da parte di alieni extra-dimensionali, lo scienziato ribelle alieno Zeku riunisce un gruppo di adolescenti dotati di vari poteri psichici, tra cui Isamu. Una volta a bordo della nave di Zeku… e abbracciata la sua missione di difendere la razza umana dall'estinzione… Isamu e i suoi compagni utilizzano l'energia mentale per creare enormi armature con cui combattere l'Impero Garadain. Nel corso della serie, i membri del gruppo si scontrano tra loro, si innamorano e combattono ovunque sia necessario per proteggere la Terra, che sia a casa, nello spazio profondo o persino mentre sono intrappolati sul pianeta alieno stesso.

info.title: The Ramparts of Ice (ITA)
info.synopsis: Socialmente incapace di relazionarsi con gli altri, Koyuki Hikawa crea un muro fra lei e le persone che la circondano. Trascorre il suo tempo al liceo in solitudine fino a quando non incontra Minato Amemiya, un ragazzo che cerca di accorciare la distanza tra loro per qualche motivo. Koyuki e Minato, la popolare Miki e il gentile Yōta, questa è la storia di quattro giovani un po' complicati che sono confusi dalle proprie vite!

episodes.title: Lines and Walls
episodes.synopsis: After her classmates run off in fear, Koyuki makes faces in a mirror to figure out why everyone finds her scary. Suddenly, a boy sneaks up behind her.

episodes.title: Locksmith
episodes.synopsis: To Koyuki's relief, Yota comes to her rescue. After their initial study session, they grow more comfortable with each other — which unsettles Minato.

episodes.title: 3+(<-)1
episodes.synopsis: Bothered that Koyuki still has her guard up around him, Minato tries to make small talk. As Miki grows suspicious of his intentions, she confronts him.

episodes.title: Impenetrable
episodes.synopsis: At Miki's prodding, Minato clarifies his interest in her best friend. An unexpected visitor triggers Koyuki's bad memories, leading to a harsh outburst.

episodes.title: Change
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki mulls over the tense exchange in the infirmary. After Yota clears the air, she tries to have an honest conversation with Minato for the first time.

episodes.title: New Semester
episodes.synopsis: As winter break ends, the usually calm Minato begins to realize his feelings are changing. Miki notices how close Yota and Koyuki have become.

episodes.title: Loneliness and Solitude
episodes.synopsis: After reflecting on her own loneliness and worrying that Yota is bottling everything up, Koyuki reaches out and asks about his true feelings.

episodes.title: On Equal Footing
episodes.synopsis: Determined not to mess up high school, Miki has faked her persona since day one. But not being herself around her classmates starts to wear her down.

episodes.title: Self-awareness
episodes.synopsis: Minato realizes how Koyuki is always on his mind. Later, while hanging out at the new mall, the misunderstanding between the four friends deepens.

episodes.title: Spring
episodes.synopsis: A spring break trip to the amusement park brings the four friends closer. Back at school, Koyuki's surprised by a familiar face — and Minato takes notice.

episodes.title: Inversion
episodes.synopsis: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

episodes.title: Thunder
episodes.synopsis: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.

episodes.title: Perception
episodes.synopsis: With Akine's words ringing in her head, Koyuki's feelings become complicated. Later, an accident causes something to shift between Miki and Yota.

episodes.title: Bombshell
episodes.synopsis: Unsure of how to move forward, Miki avoids Yota and confides in her colleagues. A bold Momoka confronts Koyuki about Minato and lights a fuse.

info.title: Horimiya (ITA)
info.synopsis: Hori può sembrare un'ordinaria adolescente, ma in realtà è una persona completamente diversa dopo la scuola: in assenza dei suoi genitori lavoro-dipendenti, Hori è stata come una madre per il fratellino sin da quando era piccola. Tra il prendersi cura del fratello, sfamare entrambi, e sbrigare le faccende domestiche, non ha molto tempo per una normale vita da adolescente. Un giorno incontra qualcun altro che non è quello che sembra a scuola: un tranquillo, occhialuto ragazzo di nome Miyamura. Le aveva dato l'impressione di un topo di biblioteca, e forse di un otaku, ma Hori non poteva sbagliarsi di più. Al di fuori della scuola, Miyamura è un ragazzo socievole con una marea di piercing e per giunta non è nemmeno molto bravo nello studio. Ora i due hanno qualcuno con cui condividere le due metà celate della propria vita!

episodes.title: A Tiny Happenstance
episodes.synopsis: Hori-san lives a double life: trendy, popular girl at school, simple, strong-willed caretaker at home. After a chance encounter with her classmate Miyamura, she finds out that she's not the only one who hides her true self away.

episodes.title: You Wear More Than One Face
episodes.synopsis: When her mother asks about Miyamura, Hori comes to a frightening realization. Later, the Student Council ropes Hori into extra work, but when conflict arises, it's up to Miyamura to smooth things over.

episodes.title: That`s Why It`s Okay
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura reflects on his past and present. Hori responds to Remi's selfish demand. A heated conversation between Ishikawa and Miyamura ends with a fistfight.

episodes.title: Everybody Loves Somebody
episodes.synopsis: The student council room becomes a cool hangout. Hori tries to get Miyamura flustered. An old friend brings out a new side of Miyamura. Later, when Hori gets sick, Miyamura comes to her rescue.

episodes.title: I Can`t Say It Out Loud
episodes.synopsis: A rumor complicates Hori and Miyamura's budding relationship. Kyosuke comes home to roost and instantly takes a liking to Miyamura. Sakura evaluates her friendship with Remi.

episodes.title: This Summer`s Going to Be a Hot One
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura ends up staying the night. Rumors spread like wildfire at school. Shindo calls the couple over to share a bag of candy. A second-year girl begins to stalk Miyamura.

episodes.title: You`re Here, I`m Here
episodes.synopsis: Sakura finds the courage to get closer to Toru. Yoshikawa struggles to voice what she truly wants. Miyamura goes away for a week-long trip. Hori worries about her horror obsession.

episodes.title: The Truth Deception Reveals
episodes.synopsis: Remi reflects on how she and Sengoku started dating. Miyamura discovers a hidden side of Hori. When Yoshikawa gets asked out, the gang gets Ishikawa to help.

episodes.title: It`s Hard, but Not Impossible
episodes.synopsis: Miyamura runs into some unfriendly faces. Hori tries to get Miyamura to fulfill her darkest desires. Mizouchi's love is unrequited. Tanihara confronts his past with Miyamura.

episodes.title: Until the Snow Melts
episodes.synopsis: Hori has an unexpected demand of Miyamura. When Yoshikawa learns her fake relationship with Ishikawa might be coming to an end, she's forced to reflect on her own feelings.

episodes.title: It May Seem Like Hate
episodes.synopsis: The gang tries to get Yanagi to loosen up. Iura is clueless as to how much he terrifies Sawada. When Iura's sister Motoko is struggling with entrance exams, Iura asks Hori to help.

episodes.title: Hitherto, and Forevermore
episodes.synopsis: Yoshikawa heads over to Ishikawa's house. Christmas brings romantic holiday cheer to all. Hori and Miyamura discuss their future.

episodes.title: I Would Gift You the Sky
episodes.synopsis: As graduation approaches, Miyamura reflects on the past year, an uncertain future, and the new life he's found.

info.title: Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc. 2
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Magilumiere Magical Girls Inc.

episodes.title: A Legitimate Job Admired by Everyone
episodes.synopsis: At a conference among industry leaders in Kaii countermeasures, Shigemoto's "Alice System" is rejected due to lack of proven results. He takes on a massive yet dangerous new project for himself to prove his abilities while questioning the industry's power dynamics and expectations. Meanwhile, a certain individual approaches Koshigaya with a suspicious proposal, putting her father on shaky ground.

episodes.title: No Logical Means of Exterminating This Kaii
episodes.synopsis: Kana and Koshigaya visit the RIMT to investigate and exterminate a new Kaii species. Guided by Vice Chief Akasaka, they face a bewildering and seemingly invincible Kaii specimen defying all common sense. Behind the scenes, ulterior motives surrounding magic power regulations cause tension as the Kaii unexpectedly mutates. With a strict time limit, Magilumiere's skills are put to the test.

episodes.title: Haven`t Seen Delusion Like This in Ages
episodes.synopsis: Magical Girls from Magilumiere and AST simultaneously face a rampaging new Kaii species. Koshigaya extends an olive branch to Tsuchiba, resulting in a clash of opinions that only sparks tension between their companies. The unknown Kaii rapidly mutates under the influence of magic power, after which a certain individual takes control as operator for the do-or-die battle ahead.

episodes.title: How Exceptional His Magical Girls Are
episodes.synopsis: An improvised collaboration between Magilumiere and AST engages in a do-or-die fight against the rapidly mutating Class C Kaii. Magilumiere's fluctuating defensive and offensive tactics upset conventional methods as Kana gathers real-time data during battle to take control. Through physicality, precise control, and high-level guidance, the seemingly unbalanced team devises a plan to counterattack.

episodes.title: Can`t Keep Acting Like a Rookie
episodes.synopsis: Magilumiere begins recruiting engineers to promote the Alice System. Kana struggles to convey the company's appeal while overseeing the interview process. This causes unexpected personnel to assemble, bringing the team a fresh atmosphere. When securing more talent proves difficult after serious attempts to strengthen their combat potential, Magilumiere heads to Kyoto for lectures and interviews.

episodes.title: You`re Not Fit for This Job
episodes.synopsis: In Kyoto, Magilumiere meets engineer candidate Yamimori, who boasts impressive skills but struggles with cooperation. While compatibility with the team is called into question, he appears to be hiding certain feelings about his childhood friend Sakae and his personal values. Meanwhile, during a festival at Tonomori Shrine, a ritual unleashes a Kaii while an ominous shadow lurks behind the scenes.

episodes.title: The Battle`s Already Over
episodes.synopsis: At the Tonomori Shrine ceremony's climax, an unknown Kaii suddenly invades a barrier once believed to be safe, enveloping the area in chaos. The barrier blocks outside forces, which separates Magilumiere's team. Makino and Akasaka are forced into a struggle within the barrier while Nikoyama searches for an opening outside. With time running out, each decision will greatly influence the outcome.

episodes.title: You Can Choose Where to Grow Up
episodes.synopsis: After gaining the trust of his allies, Yamimori takes action to fight the rampaging Kaii inside the sealed barrier. Makino and Akasaka also rechallenge the front lines to face the now-overpowered Kaii with harmonious teamwork and quick thinking. The dire situation demonstrates the skill and trust between Magical Girls and their engineers as the team marches onward with full hearts.

episodes.title: Are You Expecting Us to Sugarcoat This?
episodes.synopsis: The Kaii at Tonomori is revealed to be someone's act of sabotage promoting a scheme to ease magic regulations behind the scenes and manipulate public opinion. Then, the culprit emerges-someone entirely unexpected. While Yamimori becomes comfortable at Magilumiere, Kana decides to confront major industry norms and her own role in the process, sparking the onset of war on a much grander scale.

episodes.title: Do You Like Barley Spice?
episodes.synopsis: While deregulation advocates plot their next scheme, Magilumiere defies all precedents by waiting to ambush an enormous, unclassified, and highly irregular Kaii before it emerges. Koshigaya, Akasaka, and Makino struggle on the field as the Kaii's power escalates beyond all expectation while Nikoyama and Yamimori frantically work together on analysis and support from the operator's chair.

episodes.title: A Job You Can Bail on Has No Value
episodes.synopsis: As the battle in Tokyo Bay intensifies, Magilumiere's Magical Girls work together to take control. However, Tsuchiba from AST intervenes to turn the battle on its head with her ultra-powerful new magical device—"Wings"—aiming to single-handedly annihilate the target and contradict Magilumiere's cooperative combat style. Now, with tensions flaring, it's not just a fight against the Kaii anymore.

episodes.title: Glad I Became a Magical Girl
episodes.synopsis: Amidst the raging war, Magilumiere and AST finally decide to "cooperate" as Shigemoto gives AST full access to the Alice System's technology to combine both companies' power for shared use among their Magical Girls. Meanwhile, Tsuchiba nearly loses control of her magic. For the sake of future generations, new relationships and moral values drive everyone involved to fight with their hearts.

info.title: Mission: Yozakura Family 2 (ITA)
info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Mission: Yozakura Family 2

episodes.title: Ai Comes to the Yozakura Family / Mini Kyoichiro
episodes.synopsis: Former Tanpopo executive Ai joins the Yozakura household to reform, but peace is soon threatened.

episodes.title: Winners and Losers
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces school chaos as Bronze Rank spy Sosuke Michibata targets him with sabotage and rumors.

episodes.title: The Big Bro Shinzo Safety Watch Team
episodes.synopsis: Shinzo’s shopping trip with Ayaka turns chaotic as Kengo and Nanao secretly assist him.

episodes.title: Spy Advancement Exam
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces Shinzo in a brutal game of tag during the first stage of the Spy Exam.

episodes.title: The Fruit of Love
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo faces Kyoichiro in a terrifying final exam stage where examinees vanish into the darkness.

episodes.title: New Cherry Blossoms
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo meets a mutated Kawashita to learn how to kill Tsubomi, but his father-in-law, Momo, appears.

episodes.title: At the Old Yozakura Residence
episodes.synopsis: Mutsumi tests Taiyo’s surging powers while Futaba fails to learn tech skills from Shion.

episodes.title: Ai`s Errand / Mutsumi`s Major Diet Mission
episodes.synopsis: Ai goes on her first solo errand to cheer up the family, while a disguised Taiyo and Mutsumi follow.

episodes.title: Tsubomi & Mutsumi
episodes.synopsis: The Yozakuras' search for an ancient journal turns into a chaotic and revealing mansion cleanup.

episodes.title: Refusal
episodes.synopsis: Kyoichiro vanishes, but Taiyo’s date is cut short by a mysterious presence and an urgent summons.

episodes.title: Operation Search for the Eldest Son
episodes.synopsis: Taiyo finds Kyoichiro, who rejects the family and flees, causing a rift among the siblings.

episodes.title: Let`s Be a Family Again
episodes.synopsis: Poisoned by Tsubomi, Kyoichiro flees to save his family. Taiyo desperately chases him to save him.

info.title: Your Letter
info.synopsis: Sori è una ragazza gentile, premurosa e di sani principi. Sfortunatamente queste sue qualità la rendono anche bersaglio perfetto di bullismo. Si trasferisce quindi in una nuova scuola, e quando sembra che la storia stia per ripetersi, si imbatte in una misteriosa serie di lettere che la condurranno in una magica caccia al tesoro, in un mondo nascosto, sotto la superficie della sua nuova scuola. Un'avventura che la porterà a riscoprire l'amicizia, le meraviglie della natura e la bontà dell'umanità.
